text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, solving problems, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following strict, pre-programmed rules. A more advanced form is deep learning, which uses complex neural networks inspired by the human brain to handle very large amounts of information. You likely use AI every day without noticing it. Virtual assistants like Siri or Alexa, recommendation systems on Netflix or Spotify, spam filters in your email, and even navigation apps that suggest faster routes—all rely on AI to make your life easier and more efficient.
